title: Metadata: field physically present but inactive (PresentInactive)
description: SAR archive where HAS_PATH is set globally (field physically present in LFH) but the path field for one entry has zero length (PresentInactive). Validates three-state FieldPresence model: Absent vs PresentInactive vs PresentActive.
notes: Tests the wire-level distinction between 'field absent' (no HAS_PATH) and 'field present but zero length' (HAS_PATH, empty path).
